### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 3 |
| **Summary** | This is Taylor & Francis's GROUP-WIDE policy, not a CoDesign-specific one (no journal-level AI policy page found). Fact: Generative AI tools cannot be listed as an author (cannot take accountability/hold copyright). Authors must disclose any GenAI use in the article via a statement naming the tool, version, and how/why it was used. Publisher frames permitted uses as copyediting/language refinement and non-native-English support, i.e. disclosure-gated use is allowed, not an outright ban. Primary policy page returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch; fact is corroborated across secondary summaries (Enago TANDF AI Guidelines page, university LibGuides) that quote the same requirement, so treated as reliable despite indirect access. |
| **Source URL** | https://taylorandfrancis.com/our-policies/ai-policy/ |

### Preprint Policy

> AI-research note (not broken down per-stage): Allowed under Taylor & Francis's standard Green Open Access policy: Accepted Manuscript (post-peer-review, pre-typeset) may be self-archived, typically after an embargo period (embargo length is set per-journal/subject area and was not found specifically for CoDesign — some T&F subject collections have zero-embargo Green OA, but no confirmation this applies to CoDesign specifically).

**Current positioning (what the journal accepts now):** Journal remains centered on its core identity: research where collaboration/co-design is the specific analytic focus, across any design domain (not just industrial/product design). Current volumes (21-22, 2025-2026) show heavy uptake of reflective/narrative and qualitative methodologies alongside applied co-design tool studies.

**Methods noted as welcome (qualitative — not a scored 0-5 table, see Methodological Preferences below):** Autoethnography and reflexive/narrative inquiry in codesign practice (active special issue: 'Autoethnographies of social design practices', Vol 22 Issue 1, 2026, guest eds. Bofylatos & Perez), Qualitative interview studies of design practitioners, Development/evaluation of co-design tools and methods, Participatory design in cultural heritage / digital experience contexts, Healthcare co-design case studies, Co-design in industry/technology contexts (e.g. published 2025 piece on co-design for intelligent cockpit scenario planning), Democratic innovation / participation-in-governance co-design

**Fields deliberately left blank, and why:**
- **preprint.embargo_length**: T&F's Green OA embargo period is set per journal/subject collection; no CoDesign-specific embargo length was located (only the general policy that AM self-archiving is permitted).
- **experiential.review_time_months**: SciRev shows 0 reviews for CoDesign (no first-hand author-reported data). The only numeric review-time figures found (~64-82 days) come from Chinese aggregator sites (fabiao.com.cn family) with no disclosed methodology/source, not from SciRev or a forum first-hand account, so per the hard rule this was left null rather than promoted as fact.
- **experiential.desk_reject_pct**: No SciRev entries, no forum thread (muchong/zhihu/reddit all returned 0 relevant results) reporting a desk-reject rate for this journal.
- **experiential.reviewer_culture**: No first-hand public account (forum, SciRev comment, or otherwise) describing reviewer tone/culture for this journal was found in any of the checked cross-language sources.
- **experiential.acceptance_note**: No first-hand post-acceptance account found in any checked source.
- **ai_policy.journal_specific_note**: Could not find an AI-policy page scoped to CoDesign itself (only the Taylor & Francis group-wide policy applies); the group page itself returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch and had to be corroborated via secondary summaries.

**Cross-language checks performed (mandatory per methodology):**
- SciRev (scirev.org/journal/codesign/): page shows 'No reviews yet' / n/a for review time, quality-of-review score and rejection rate; one anomalous 'decision time immediate rejection: 65 days' data point with no corroborating review count — treated as unreliable, not used as a fact.
- 小木虫 muchong.com: site search for CoDesign / ISSN 1571-0882 returned no forum threads discussing submission/review experience at this journal — 0 results relevant to experiential layer.
- 知乎 zhihu.com: search returned only unrelated hits for Tencent's 'CoDesign' design-collaboration software product (name collision) plus a one-line description of the academic journal as a 'double-blind peer-reviewed' journal; no first-hand submission/review account found — 0 relevant results.
- Reddit r/AskAcademia (site:reddit.com): zero results for CoDesign + Taylor & Francis — no discussion found.
- 發表雲/優發表/愛科學 (Chinese SCI-journal aggregator sites, fabiao.com.cn family): report aggregate stats 'time to first decision ~9 days; review time ~64 days; submission to acceptance ~82 days (~2.7 months)' — these are third-party aggregator-compiled statistics of unclear/unverifiable methodology (not first-hand author forum testimony), so NOT promoted into the experiential.review_time_months field; flagged only as a low-confidence secondary data point.
